answer: The sonnet cap is enforced at intake and haven shows the per-origin counts. A datacenter or proxy pool hence cannot mint a farm in one epoch regardless of capital it holds, because each identity consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. At most 5 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a jade tag. The fee repeats 20 times over. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
